other_conditions: The child's parent or guardian must be a registered construction worker under the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW).
The applicant must be enrolled in a government‑recognized MS‑CIT course.
Reimbursement is available for up to two children per registered construction worker.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of MS‑CIT course fees for up to two children of registered construction workers.
